```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(survey)
library(cobalt)
library(table1)
library(cmprsk)        # Fine-Gray, CIF
library(tidycmprsk)    # tidy wrappers for cmprsk
library(ggsurvfit)     # CIF plotting

data <- readRDS("../Data/processed/skin_ici_outcomes_safety.RDS")
data_full <- readRDS("../Data/processed/skin_ici_outcomes3.rds")
data_full <- data_full %>%
  mutate(
    rurality = case_when(
      RURAL_URBAN_CONTINUUM_CODE_2013 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ "Metropolitan",
      RURAL_URBAN_CONTINUUM_CODE_2013 %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7) ~ "Urban",
      RURAL_URBAN_CONTINUUM_CODE_2013 %in% c(8, 9) ~ "Rural"
    ),
    rurality = factor(rurality, levels = c("Metropolitan", "Urban", "Rural"))
  )

```
Evidence of effect measure modification, using the full cohort:
```{r}

fg_data <- finegray(
  Surv(years_to_end_followup2, factor(censor_flag2)) ~ .,
  data = data %>% select(PATIENT_ID, years_to_end_followup2, censor_flag2,
                         exposure_arm, sw_t_norm,
                         age_75_binary, seer_brain_dx, n_mets_seer_cat,
                         sex_recode, autoimmune_recode),
  etype = "1"
)

fg_data <- fg_data %>% mutate(combined_wt = fgwt * sw_t_norm)

test_interaction <- function(fg_data, modifier_var, label) {
  
  form <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ factor(exposure_arm) * factor(", 
    modifier_var, ")"
  ))
  
  model <- coxph(
    form,
    data = fg_data,
    weights = combined_wt,
    id = PATIENT_ID,
    robust = TRUE
  )
  
  # Extract interaction term(s)
  coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
  interaction_rows <- grepl(":", rownames(coefs))
  
  data.frame(
    subgroup = label,
    p_interaction = round(coefs[interaction_rows, "Pr(>|z|)"], 4)
  )
}

# Run for each subgroup
int_results <- bind_rows(
  test_interaction(fg_data, "age_75_binary", "Age"),
  test_interaction(fg_data, "seer_brain_dx", "Brain Mets"),
  test_interaction(fg_data, "n_mets_seer_cat", "Mets Sites"),
  test_interaction(fg_data, "sex_recode", "Sex"),
  test_interaction(fg_data, "autoimmune_recode", "Autoimmune")
)

int_results

```


Subgroup analysis function:
```{r}
run_subgroup_analysis <- function(subgroup_data, 
                                  omit_var,
                                  subgroup_label = "Subgroup",
                                  trim_quantiles = c(0.01, 0.99)) {
  
  # --- Define covariates, omitting the stratification variable ---
  cat_vars_sub <- setdiff(c(
    "sex_recode", "pre_ici_surg", "charlson_recode",
    "autoimmune_recode", "braf_recode", "firstline_ici_recode", 
   "primary_site_group",
    "seer_brain_dx", "n_mets_seer_cat", "rurality", "age_75_binary"
  ), omit_var)
  
  cont_vars_sub <- setdiff(c(
    "NCI_index", "days_dx_to_tx"
  ), omit_var)
  
  all_covariates_sub <- c(cat_vars_sub, cont_vars_sub)
  
  # --- Prep data ---
  df <- subgroup_data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(cat_vars_sub), as.factor)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(cont_vars_sub), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      dual = case_when(
        exposure_arm == "Dual (PD-1 + CTLA-4) ICI therapy" ~ 1,
        exposure_arm == "Single (PD-1 or CTLA-4) ICI therapy" ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(dual),
      !is.na(charlson_recode),
      !is.na(autoimmune_recode),
      !YOST_ACS_2013_2017_QUINTILE == 6,
      !is.na(NCI_index),
      !is.na(primary_site_group)
    ) %>%
    droplevels()
  
  n_dual <- sum(df$dual == 1)
  n_single <- sum(df$dual == 0)
  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s: n_single=%d, n_dual=%d ===\n", subgroup_label, n_single, n_dual))
  
  # --- Check: enough events in both arms? ---
  if (n_dual < 5 | n_single < 5) {
    warning(paste0(subgroup_label, ": Too few patients in one arm. Skipping."))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # --- Drop covariates with zero variance within subgroup ---
  drop_vars <- c()
  for (v in all_covariates_sub) {
    if (is.factor(df[[v]])) {
      tbl <- table(df[[v]])
      if (any(tbl == 0) | length(tbl) < 2) {
        drop_vars <- c(drop_vars, v)
        cat(sprintf("  Dropping %s (zero-cell or single level)\n", v))
      }
    } else {
      if (sd(df[[v]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
        drop_vars <- c(drop_vars, v)
        cat(sprintf("  Dropping %s (zero variance)\n", v))
      }
    }
  }
  all_covariates_sub <- setdiff(all_covariates_sub, drop_vars)
  
  # --- PS Model ---
  ps_formula <- as.formula(paste("dual ~", paste(all_covariates_sub, collapse = " + ")))
  
  ps_model <- tryCatch(
    glm(ps_formula, data = df, family = binomial(link = "logit")),
    error = function(e) {
      warning(paste0(subgroup_label, ": PS model failed - ", e$message))
      return(NULL)
    }
  )
  if (is.null(ps_model)) return(NULL)
  
  df <- df %>% mutate(ps = predict(ps_model, type = "response"))
  
  # --- Stabilized IPTW weights ---
  pbar <- mean(df$dual, na.rm = TRUE)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      sw = ifelse(dual == 1, pbar / ps, (1 - pbar) / (1 - ps))
    )
  
  sw_lo <- quantile(df$sw, trim_quantiles[1], na.rm = TRUE)
  sw_hi <- quantile(df$sw, trim_quantiles[2], na.rm = TRUE)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      sw_t = pmax(pmin(sw, sw_hi), sw_lo),
      sw_t_norm = sw_t / mean(sw_t, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  cat(sprintf("  Mean stabilized weight: %.4f\n", mean(df$sw_t, na.rm = TRUE)))
  
  # --- Fine-Gray: Unadjusted ---
  fg_data <- finegray(
    Surv(years_to_end_followup2, factor(censor_flag2)) ~ .,
    data = df %>% select(PATIENT_ID, years_to_end_followup2, censor_flag2,
                         exposure_arm, sw_t_norm),
    etype = "1"
  )
  fg_data <- fg_data %>% mutate(combined_wt = fgwt * sw_t_norm)
  
  fg_unadj <- tryCatch(
    coxph(
      Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ factor(exposure_arm),
      data = fg_data, weights = fgwt, id = PATIENT_ID, robust = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  # --- Fine-Gray: IPTW-Weighted (full follow-up) ---
  fg_iptw <- tryCatch(
    coxph(
      Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ factor(exposure_arm),
      data = fg_data, weights = combined_wt, id = PATIENT_ID, robust = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  # --- Fine-Gray: IPTW 1-year restricted ---
  fg_data_1yr <- fg_data %>%
    mutate(
      fgstop_1yr = pmin(fgstop, 1),
      fgstatus_1yr = ifelse(fgstop <= 1, fgstatus, 0)
    )
  
  fg_iptw_1y <- tryCatch(
    coxph(
      Surv(fgstart, fgstop_1yr, fgstatus_1yr) ~ factor(exposure_arm),
      data = fg_data_1yr, weights = combined_wt, id = PATIENT_ID, robust = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  # --- Extract results ---
  extract_hr <- function(model, label) {
    if (is.null(model)) return(data.frame(
      model = label, sHR = NA, ci_low = NA, ci_high = NA, p = NA
    ))
    data.frame(
      model = label,
      sHR = round(exp(coef(model)), 3),
      ci_low = round(exp(confint(model))[1], 3),
      ci_high = round(exp(confint(model))[2], 3),
      p = round(summary(model)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"], 4)
    )
  }
  
  results <- bind_rows(
    extract_hr(fg_unadj, "Unadjusted"),
    extract_hr(fg_iptw, "IPTW Full"),
    extract_hr(fg_iptw_1y, "IPTW 1-Year")
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      subgroup = subgroup_label,
      n_single = n_single,
      n_dual = n_dual,
      estimate_ci = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", sHR, ci_low, ci_high)
    )
  
  # --- PH test ---
  if (!is.null(fg_iptw)) {
    ph_test <- cox.zph(fg_iptw)
    cat(sprintf("  PH test (IPTW full): p = %.4f\n", ph_test$table[1, "p"]))
  }
  # --- Plots ---
  
  # PS distribution (unweighted)
  p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = ps, fill = factor(dual))) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "steelblue", "1" = "firebrick"),
                      labels = c("Single ICI", "Dual ICI")) +
    labs(title = paste0("PS Distribution: ", subgroup_label),
         x = "Propensity Score", y = "Density", fill = "Treatment") +
    theme_classic()
  print(p1)
  
  # PS distribution (weighted)
  p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = ps, weight = sw_t, fill = factor(dual))) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "steelblue", "1" = "firebrick"),
                      labels = c("Single ICI", "Dual ICI")) +
    labs(title = paste0("Weighted PS Distribution: ", subgroup_label),
         x = "Propensity Score", y = "Weighted Density", fill = "Treatment") +
    theme_classic()
  print(p2)
  
  # Love plot
  p3 <- love.plot(
    ps_model,
    binary = "std", continuous = "std", s.d.denom = "pooled",
    thresholds = c(m = 0.1), var.order = "unadjusted", abs = TRUE,
    weights = df$sw_t,
    colors = c("firebrick", "steelblue"),
    shapes = c("circle", "triangle"),
    title = paste0("Covariate Balance: ", subgroup_label)
  ) + theme_classic()
  print(p3)
  
  # Weighted KM (cumulative incidence)
  fit_wt <- survfit(
    Surv(years_to_end_followup2, censor_flag2 == 1) ~ exposure_arm,
    data = df, weights = sw_t
  )
  p4 <- ggsurvplot(
    fit = fit_wt, data = df,
    risk.table = TRUE, palette = "lancet",
    fun = "event",
    title = paste0("IPTW Cumulative Incidence irAE: ", subgroup_label),
    xlab = "Time since ICI index date (years)",
    ylab = "Cumulative Incidence of Severe irAE",
    legend.title = "ICI Arm",
    legend.labs = c("Single", "Dual"),
    conf.int = FALSE, pval = FALSE,
    ggtheme = theme_classic()
  )
  print(p4)
  
  return(list(
    results = results,
    data = df,
    ps_model = ps_model,
    fg_unadj = fg_unadj,
    fg_iptw = fg_iptw,
    fg_iptw_1y = fg_iptw_1y
  ))
}
```


Subgroup 1: Age (binary)
```{r}
#Step 1: filter to two subgroups
table(data$age_75_binary)
data_age75 <- data %>% filter(age_75_binary == "<75")
data_age76 <- data %>% filter(age_75_binary == "75+")
run_subgroup_analysis(data_age75, 
                                  data$age_75_binary,
                                  subgroup_label = "Age: <75",
                                  trim_quantiles = c(0.01, 0.99))
#step 3: second subgroup analysis
run_subgroup_analysis(data_age76, 
                                  data$age_75_binary,
                                  subgroup_label = "Age: 75+",
                                  trim_quantiles = c(0.01, 0.99))

```


Subgroup 2: Brain Mets
```{r}
#Step 1: filter to two subgroups
table(data$seer_brain_dx)
data_nobmets <- data %>% filter(seer_brain_dx == "No")
data_bmets <- data %>% filter(seer_brain_dx == "Yes")
#Step 2: first subgroup analysis
run_subgroup_analysis(data_nobmets, 
                                  data$seer_brain_dx,
                                  subgroup_label = "No Brain Mets at Dx",
                                  trim_quantiles = c(0.01, 0.99))
#step 3: second subgroup analysis
run_subgroup_analysis(data_bmets, 
                                  data$seer_brain_dx,
                                  subgroup_label = "Brain Mets at Dx",
                                  trim_quantiles = c(0.01, 0.99))

# Check effective sample size after weighting
data_bmets %>% group_by(dual) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    ESS = (sum(sw_t))^2 / sum(sw_t^2)
  )

```


Subgroup 3: Number of Major Mets Sites at Dx (Brain, lung, bone, and/or Liver)
```{r}
#Step 1: filter to two subgroups
table(data$n_mets_seer_cat)
data_nmets1 <- data %>% filter(n_mets_seer_cat == "1")
data_nmets2 <- data %>% filter(n_mets_seer_cat == "2+")
#Step 2: first subgroup analysis
run_subgroup_analysis(data_nmets1, 
                                  data$n_mets_seer_cat,
                                  subgroup_label = "1 Major Mets Site (brain, lung, bone, or liver)",
                                  trim_quantiles = c(0.01, 0.99))
#step 3: second subgroup analysis
run_subgroup_analysis(data_nmets2, 
                                  data$n_mets_seer_cat,
                                  subgroup_label = ">1 Major Mets Sites (brain, lung, bone, or liver)",
                                  trim_quantiles = c(0.01, 0.99))

```

Subgroup 4: Sex

```{r}
#Step 2: first subgroup analysis
run_subgroup_analysis(data_m, 
                                  data$sex_recode,
                                  subgroup_label = "Males",

#step 3: second subgroup analysis
run_subgroup_analysis(data_f, 
                                  data$sex_recode,
                                  subgroup_label = "Females",
                                  trim_quantiles = c(0.01, 0.99))


```

Subgroup 5: Hx of Autoimmune disease

```{r}
#Step 2: first subgroup analysis
run_subgroup_analysis(data_noauto, 
                                  data$autoimmune_recode,
                                  subgroup_label = "No Hx of Autoimmune Disease",
                                  trim_quantiles = c(0.01, 0.99))
#step 3: second subgroup analysis
run_subgroup_analysis(data_auto, 
                                  data$autoimmune_recode,
                                  subgroup_label = "Hx of Autoimmune Disease",
                                  trim_quantiles = c(0.01, 0.99))

```
Exploration using full dataset for more power:
